reason: On the draw, two lands with two cheap Bitter Triumphs and a 3- and 4-drop is a fine keep against an aggro Dragons deck; a mulligan to six is worse.

The flying Anchorage is the lethal threat and the opponent's three ground blockers can absorb the ground attackers anyway, so sending the Robot adds nothing and leaves me at 5 with no blocker against the crack-back.
Mauler plus Boots, equipped for free, adds a hasty attacker with ward for about 7 lifelink damage against an empty board; Chainsaw has no target and does nothing this turn.
There is no land in hand, so both choices come to the same thing: cast Sleight of Hand and play a land only if it finds one.
A land was already played this turn, so the Swamp cannot be played; both choices just cast Forsaken Miner.

The all-in attack is one short of lethal (the two blockers stop 10 of 20, leaving 10 against 11 life) and leaves me at 1 with everything tapped, dead to any hasty Lizard via Rockface Village; attacking with two still puts them to 1 or costs them creatures while keeping blockers home.

Bouncing the Crab now uses mana that would otherwise go unspent and sets up a cheap flash Crab to tap their attackers next turn; holding Get Out allows the same trick for 2 more mana and keeps the counter mode, so the two roughly balance.
Hearth Elemental makes Sunderflock cost 3, which I can cast now; attacking into an untapped blocker with BR open (Stingerquill Charm deathtouch) risks losing it for only 4 damage.

Cori Mountain Monastery is not in hand, so A is really Day of Judgment plus a second Tablet I don't need; Day of Judgment plus Consult at end step keeps No More Lies or card selection open, which is better for control.

The only trigger to counter now is the warped Hellkite's exile trigger, which I want to resolve; holding Tidebinder to stop a Magmatic Hellkite or other ETB trigger is worth more than a 3/2 body at end step.
